row.team_price_text: Recruit Pro: from $335/mo billed annually (flat, up to 50 employees)
row.evidence: Spark Hire Recruit's IdP integration guides (Okta, Entra ID, JumpCloud, OneLogin) are marked 'Plan: Enterprise' and set up user provisioning with a Recruit token against https://app.comeet.co/scim; Recruit Enterprise is 'Talk to Sales' on the pricing page.
row.notes: Spark Hire now sells two products: Recruit (ATS, formerly Comeet) and Video Interviews. The row follows Recruit, the product with directory provisioning; Video Interviews ($249/mo billed annually with unlimited users, or $299/mo monthly for up to 5 users) has SSO only, via WorkOS, as an Enterprise/paid add-on, with no SCIM documented. Pricing changed since June: the Lite $149 / Pro $299 / Growth $499 flat plans are gone; Recruit Pro starts at $335/mo and Growth at $499/mo billed annually (annual contract only, up to 50 employees, scaling with headcount). June's 'SCIM via WorkOS' claim has no first-party source (Spark Hire's WorkOS article covers SSO only) and is dropped. The pricing table shows Recruit SSO as an add-on on Pro/Growth and included on Enterprise, while every Recruit SSO/provisioning guide says 'Plan: Enterprise'; SCIM is gated either way (confidence medium because the SCIM plan comes from help docs). Groups are not provisioned (Microsoft: connector does not support groups; JumpCloud guide disables group management).

scim.notes: Provisioning is configured as part of each IdP's SSO integration guide (sso_required true); scim false on Pro/Growth is inferred from the guides' 'Plan: Enterprise' label.

auth.token_source: Recruit: Settings > System > Authentication & Security (Okta OAuth Bearer Token / Secret Token field)

deprovision.data_retained: Teammate is marked 'Deactivated by SSO'; their tasks and position roles must be reassigned via Deactivate in Recruit.

attributes.notes: Docs only say first name and last name are required (mapping tables are screenshots).

roles.how: Roles are not provisioned; permissions come from company, position and location roles set in Recruit.

limitations.text: Users without a first and last name are not provisioned.
Provisioned users are not automatically invited; an existing Recruit user must invite them.
Activating SSO logs out all users.

user_api.notes: API access is a paid add-on (included on Recruit Enterprise / Meet Enterprise) but no public user-management API reference was found.

okta.notes: OIN 'Comeet' app marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Comeet Recruiting Software'; Microsoft lists no group support.

google.notes: Google autoprovisioning with a Comeet access token; protocol not stated.

onelogin.notes: From Spark Hire's OneLogin guide (bearer token, Enable provisioning); OneLogin's own page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: From Spark Hire's JumpCloud guide; JumpCloud's own catalogue page not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations exist for Recruit (not a directory sync).
